ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for scratches or chips. 2. Check the lens housing for impact cracks or loose retaining ring. 3. Inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there any lens scratches, chips, or contamination present?

ground_truth.node_text: Lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the lens is clean and undamaged.

ground_truth.node_text: Lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the lighting intensity within the specified range at the part plane?

ground_truth.node_text: Lighting intensity within specified range at part plane?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the illuminance readings are all within specification at center and corners.

ground_truth.node_text: Lighting intensity within specified range at part plane?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the image sharpness within the sharpness specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Image sharpness within sharpness specification specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the modulation transfer function is below the acceptance threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Image sharpness within sharpness specification specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the focus ring or working distance to bring it within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust focus ring or working distance to specification

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Focus adjustment complete.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust focus ring or working distance to specification

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the focus after the lens adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify focus after lens adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The sharpness is still below specification after the adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify focus after lens adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform a secondary lens adjustment. Clean all optical surfaces with dry nitrogen and reseat the lens body firmly in the mount before tightening the retaining ring. Check the lens mount datum face for swarf or contamination that would cause tilt, then adjust the focus drive mechanism in point-one turn increments and allow the mount to settle.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary lens adjustment: clean all optical surfaces with dry nitrogen and reseat the lens body firmly in the mount before tightening the retaining ring. Check the lens mount datum face for swarf or contamination that would cause tilt. Adjust the focus drive mechanism in 0.1 turn increments and allow the mount to settle before returning to the sharpness measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Secondary adjustment completed. All surfaces cleaned, lens reseated, and focus drive adjusted incrementally.

turns.utterance: No, the maximum distortion at the corners exceeds the half-pixel tolerance.

turns.utterance: Apply the lens distortion correction coefficients in the vision software.

turns.utterance: Distortion correction coefficients applied.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Place the standard chessboard calibration target on the presentation fixture at the nominal focal distance. Capture five images from five different target orientations, then run the calibration routine and record the reprojection error.

ground_truth.node_text: Place the standard chessboard calibration target on the presentation fixture at the nominal focal distance. Capture five images from five different target orientations as required by the calibration algorithm. Run the calibration routine in the vision software and record the reprojection error; confirm the result is below the limit stated in the vision system commissioning record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Calibration complete. Five images captured and calibration routine executed.

ground_truth.node_text: Place the standard chessboard calibration target on the presentation fixture at the nominal focal distance. Capture five images from five different target orientations as required by the calibration algorithm. Run the calibration routine in the vision software and record the reprojection error; confirm the result is below the limit stated in the vision system commissioning record.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the calibration residual error within point-one pixels root mean square?

ground_truth.node_text: Calibration residual error within 0.1 px root mean square?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the reprojection error exceeds the point-one pixel threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Calibration residual error within 0.1 px root mean square?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Rerun the calibration with new target images, using a minimum of twenty poses.

ground_truth.node_text: Rerun calibration with new target images, 20 poses minimum

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm trying to rerun the calibration but the camera mounting bracket has a visible crack near the left bolt hole and the whole assembly is wobbling - this wasn't in any of the checklist items.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Recalibration complete with twenty-two target poses captured.

ground_truth.node_text: Rerun calibration with new target images, 20 poses minimum

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the calibration residual after recalibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify calibration residual after recalibration

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The calibration residual is now within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify calibration residual after recalibration

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the trigger delay within plus or minus point-five milliseconds of specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Trigger delay within ±0.5 ms of specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured delay between sensor and trigger is within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Trigger delay within ±0.5 ms of specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the false reject rate below point-five percent?

ground_truth.node_text: False reject rate below 0.5%?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the false reject rate from the two-hundred part sample is point-three percent.

ground_truth.node_text: False reject rate below 0.5%?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all known rejects correctly detected?

ground_truth.node_text: All known rejects correctly detected?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, one of the ten defective parts was incorrectly accepted by the system.

ground_truth.node_text: All known rejects correctly detected?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure ending with escalation required. Detection capability is insufficient and an algorithm review is needed. Please escalate this issue to the vision engineering team immediately.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: detection capability insufficient, algorithm review required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I will escalate to the vision engineering team right away.
